title: Arbiter rulings output
description: What the arbiter agent returns: one ruling per disputed item, exactly once. Documentation for the arbiter prompt; validateRulings() in pipeline/lib/triage.mjs enforces it (including that every expected id appears once and no unknown id does).

id.description: Codex finding id the ruling is about.

ruling.description: ACCEPT: fix in this PR. FOLLOW-UP: real but out of scope. REJECT: not a real problem or not worth doing.

confidence.description: low sends the item to a human. medium is accepted and stands like high; prefer high or low.

reasoning.description: At most three sentences, citing file:line.
